articles.summary: The South St. Paul Mayor's Youth Task Force uses a Union Pacific Foundation grant to have a bigger impact on their community.
articles.title: UP-sponsored South St. Paul Youth Task Force Has Global Impact

articles.summary: Soarex, a NASA sounding rocket, was launched into space with a Digi XBee® on-board. The three-node network was the first Digi XBee Zigbee network to go to space.
articles.title: One Small Step for XBee, One Giant Leap for Wireless
